channelName, COALESCE(ca.channel_name, om.source_label_snapshot, '自来客') AS orderChannelName, om.order_type AS orderType, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, CAST(om.poi_id AS om.poi_name_snapshot) AS poiName, COALESCE(rc.name, om.room_category_name_snapshot) AS roomCategoryName, COALESCE(gm.name, om.stay_type_snapshot, '全日房') AS roomCategoryProductName, COALESCE(r.room_name, om.room_name_snapshot) AS roomName, om.contract_no AS contractNo, om.next_payment_amount_cent AS nextPaymentAmountCent, CAST(om.next_payment_date AS DATETIME) AS nextPaymentDate, om.payment_cycle AS paymentCycle FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id LEFT JOIN distribution_order do ON do.source_order_id = om.order_id AND do.camp_id = om.camp_id AND do.channel_id = om.channel_id LEFT JOIN pms_poi poi ON poi.poi_id = om.poi_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id LEFT JOIN goods_main gm ON gm.goods_id = om.goods_id AND gm.camp_id = om.camp_id AND gm.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN payment_way pw ON pw.payment_way_id = om.payment_way_id AND pw.camp_id = om.camp_id AND pw.is_deleted = 0 WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0
AND ( CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.out_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.guest_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.guest_mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(gm.name, om.stay_type_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(rc.name, om.room_category_name_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(r.room_name, om.room_name_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(poi.poi_name, om.poi_name_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(ca.channel_name, om.source_label_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY om.created_at DESC, om.order_id DESC

SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, COALESCE(ca.channel_name, om.source_label_snapshot, '未知渠道') AS channelName, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, COALESCE(rc.name, om.room_category_name_snapshot) AS roomCategoryName, COALESCE(r.room_name, om.room_name_snapshot) AS roomName, om.status AS orderStatus, om.start_at AS startAt, om.end_at AS endAt, om.day_num AS dayNum, om.created_at AS createdAt FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.order_type = 'daily_room' AND om.status IN ('booked', 'checked_in', 'pending')
AND ( CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.out_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.guest_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.guest_mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(rc.name, om.room_category_name_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(r.room_name, om.room_name_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(ca.channel_name, om.source_label_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY om.start_at ASC, om.created_at ASC, om.order_id ASC

SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, om.order_no AS orderNo, om.out_order_no AS outOrderId, om.order_type AS orderType, om.status AS status, om.payment_status AS paymentStatus, COALESCE(CAST(ca.channel_id AS CHAR), '0') AS channelId, COALESCE(ca.channel_name, om.source_label_snapshot, '自来客') AS channelName, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, CAST(om.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, COALESCE(poi.poi_name, om.poi_name_snapshot) AS poiName, CAST(om.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, COALESCE(rc.name, om.room_category_name_snapshot) AS roomCategoryName, CAST(om.room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, COALESCE(r.room_name, om.room_name_snapshot) AS roomName, om.start_at AS startAt, om.end_at AS endAt, om.day_num AS dayNum, om.total_price_cent AS totalPriceCent, om.total_pay_price_cent AS totalPayPriceCent, om.refund_price_cent AS refundPriceCent, COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0) AS commissionPriceCent, CAST(om.payment_way_id AS CHAR) AS paymentWayId, pw.payment_way_name AS paymentWayName, om.remark AS remark, om.created_at AS createdAt FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id LEFT JOIN distribution_order do ON do.source_order_id = om.order_id AND do.camp_id = om.camp_id AND do.channel_id = om.channel_id LEFT JOIN pms_poi poi ON poi.poi_id = om.poi_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id LEFT JOIN payment_way pw ON pw.payment_way_id = om.payment_way_id AND pw.camp_id = om.camp_id AND pw.is_deleted = 0 WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.order_id = #{orderId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(og.id AS CHAR) AS guestId, og.guest_name AS guestName, og.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, og.guest_id_card_type AS guestIdCardType, og.guest_id_card AS guestIdCard, og.guest_type AS guestType FROM order_guest og WHERE og.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY og.id ASC

SELECT CAST(opr.order_payment_record_id AS CHAR) AS paymentRecordId, CAST(opr.payment_type_id AS CHAR) AS paymentTypeId, CAST(opr.payment_way_id AS CHAR) AS paymentWayId, pw.payment_way_name AS paymentWayName, opr.is_income AS isIncome, opr.amount_cent AS amount, opr.debt_amount_cent AS debtAmount, opr.payment_no AS paymentNo, opr.payment_time AS paymentTime, opr.operator_name AS operatorName, opr.remark AS remark FROM order_payment_record opr LEFT JOIN payment_way pw ON pw.payment_way_id = opr.payment_way_id AND pw.camp_id = opr.camp_id AND pw.is_deleted = 0 WHERE opr.camp_id = #{campId} AND opr.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY opr.payment_time ASC, opr.order_payment_record_id ASC

SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, CAST(om.camp_id AS CHAR) AS campId, om.order_no AS orderNo, om.status AS status, om.payment_status AS paymentStatus, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, COALESCE(rc.name, om.room_category_name_snapshot) AS roomCategoryName, COALESCE(r.room_name, om.room_name_snapshot) AS roomName, CAST(COALESCE(ca.channel_id, 0) AS CHAR) AS channelId, COALESCE(ca.channel_name, om.source_label_snapshot, '') AS channelName, om.start_at AS startAt, om.created_at AS createdAt FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.status IN ('pending', 'refunding', 'cancelled', 'refunded')
AND ( CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.out_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.guest_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.guest_mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(rc.name, om.room_category_name_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(r.room_name, om.room_name_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(ca.channel_name, om.source_label_snapshot, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY CASE om.status WHEN 'pending' THEN 0 WHEN 'refunding' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, om.created_at ASC, om.order_id ASC
